name: WF2- Error Handler dan Monitoring KPU (execution log)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ingestion.error_logs (
    workflow_name,
    workflow_id,
    execution_id,
    node_name,
    error_message,
    error_stack,
    source_url,
    status,
    occurred_at
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    $7,
    'open',
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (
    workflow_id,
    execution_id,
    node_name
)
WHERE workflow_id IS NOT NULL
  AND execution_id IS NOT NULL
  AND node_name IS NOT NULL
DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    id,
    workflow_name,
    node_name,
    error_message,
    status,
    occurred_at;

SELECT indexname, indexdef
FROM pg_indexes
WHERE schemaname = 'ingestion'
  AND tablename = 'error_logs';
